#6632. A Complete Timeline of Zendaya and Tom Holland’s Romantic Relationship

Every item on this page was chosen by an ELLE editor. We may earn commission on some of the items you choose to buy.

In 2021, Spider-Man: No Way Home co-stars Zendaya and Tom Holland confirmed they are in a romantic relationship after years of off-and-on rumors that they were dating. In 2025, TMZ confirmed that they were engaged after Zendaya debuted her engagement ring at the Golden Globes. In June 2026, Holland confirmed they had secretly gotten married months before.

Zendaya and Holland have been playing Spider-Man love interests Peter Parker and MJ in the franchise since 2017, but met on set in 2016. They’ve obviously been close, but it was in July 2021 that the paparazzi caught them kissing at a stoplight, giving those rumors some more legitimacy.

The couple still keeps their personal lives private, but these are the notable moments in the timeline of their relationship so far. Here, their full history.

Holland was the first to post a photo of Zendaya, but soon they were appearing on one another’s Instagram feeds regularly. In July 2016, he shared a pic of them with another friend at the pool, captioned, “Summer Sunday’s.”

Zendaya posted their shared The Hollywood Reporter cover just a few months later, writing, “Amidst all the chaos and sadness...this one good thing did happen to me today. Honored to share it with the very best...Spider-Man himself.”

Holland and Zendaya’s chemistry on-screen transferred easily to the red carpet, and photos of them being playful with one another at the San Diego Comic-Con were widely circulated by fans.

In May 2017, they started attending events together, possibly because of promotional opportunities, but photos taken of them show a more personal relationship, like this photo from the MTV Movie and TV Awards.

Throughout the month, they were frequently photographed together as they promoted Spider-Man, but it seemed like the easy chemistry of two familiar colleagues.

In July 2017, a source confirmed to People that they are together.

“They started seeing each other while they were filming Spider-Man,” the source said. “They’ve been super careful to keep it private and out of the public eye, but they’ve gone on vacations with each other and try and spend as much time as possible with one another.”

A second insider added, “They’re both really ambitious, and they challenge each other—but, most importantly, they make each other crack up. They seem to have a really similar sense of humor and love joking around together. They have great banter back and forth.”

Before the Spider-Man: Homecoming premiere in June, Holland was gushing to People about his friendship with Zendaya, saying, “We are like the best of friends. She’s so great and amazing. I’m a little worried [about dealing with fame … [but] Zendaya is super famous and she’s been through this and I just call her up and say, ‘How do I manage being famous?’ I’m very glad I have a friend like her.”

The pair addressed the dating rumors above by tweeting to one another about the idea they’ve gone on vacation together.

“Wait wait...my favorite is when it says we go on vacations together HA! I haven't been on a vacation in years! hbu?” Zendaya wrote to Holland.

He joked back, “Does the press tour count?”

The next month, Zendaya denied the rumors again in an interview with Variety.

“We are friends,” she said. “He’s a great dude. He’s literally one of my best friends. This past how many months we’ve had to do press tours together. There’s very few people that will understand what that’s like at 20 years old.”

The next month, Zendaya told fans she’d been cheated on in the past and why it left her a bit skeptical about relationships early in life.

“I’m so anti being in a committed relationship when you’re young and people are learning and growing, because when people are young, they make bad decisions sometimes because they don’t know any better,” she explained. “It doesn’t mean they don’t know the difference between right and wrong—it just means that they’re still in the experimental phase in their life where they haven’t made the right decisions yet…it’s very hard to be in a relationship when the both of you are still figuring out life. You cannot change anybody. You cannot make someone grow up faster than they’re supposed to.”

At this point, Holland had spent time with Zendaya’s parents, meeting them at a steakhouse in New York.

In March 2018, the two stars sat together at the Oscars, though they walked the carpet separately. They were seen later that month at a comic book store in Los Angeles.

Zendaya attended the Met Gala, wearing a Joan of Arc-inspired chainmail Versace gown, and Holland posted a photo of her to his Instagram writing, “All hail the queen. Killing it mate.”

The next month, Zendaya posted a video of Holland goofing off with a lightsaber to wish him a happy birthday. She captioned the video: “Happy birthday loser…”

In September, Holland celebrated Zendaya’s birthday with a paparazzi photo from their date at the comic book store and a statue of Spider-Man.

“Me, myself and the birthday girl. Happy birthday mate - keep killing it and paving the way for the rest of us,” he wrote, adding a heart.

But then a few days later, Skai Jackson’s mother said on Instagram that they are, in fact, a couple.

“Yes. It’s true. They been on the low for a while,” she wrote.

She then denied she was the commenter using her screen name. “Nothing posted or said was me. I could [sic] care less or know who was dating who. Please stop asking.”

Holland and Zendaya began their Spider-Man: Far From Home press tour, and when Holland posted an Instagram of himself, Zendaya, and co-star Jacob Batalon, he accidentally tagged her name in a very suggestive place.

“I’m assuming because you don’t know how to work ig, that’s the reasoning behind my name placement,” she commented with five laughing emojis.

Holland edited the tag and wrote, “Thanks @zendaya for making me aware of my obvious blunder.”

Holland shot down the Zendaya dating rumors again. The actor told ELLE in an interview that he is single and not romantically involved with anyone. He admitted he is “definitely a relationship person. I’m not the fleeting type at all; it’s not my way of life.”

Zendaya was seen with her Euphoria co-star Jacob Elordi on vacation in Greece. Zendaya never confirmed she was dating Elordi, but paparazzi did catch Elordi giving her a kiss in New York City in February 2020. By September of that year, Elordi seemed to be dating Kaia Gerber. (They ultimately broke up in November 2021.)

Tom Holland appeared to go Instagram official with Nadia Parkes, who he was supposedly spending lockdown with in London.

Then, two years after denying they’re a couple, the Spider-Man co-stars were spotted together in Holland’s car sharing a kiss at a red light in L.A. They were then seen in the Silver Lake neighborhood the same day, leaving Zendaya’s mother Claire Stoermer’s residence.

Tom Holland shared a mirror selfie of himself with Zendaya on the set of Spider-Man, captioning it, “My MJ, have the happiest of birthdays. Gimme a call when your [sic] up xxx.”

Later that month, Zendaya posted photos of herself on the red carpet for the Venice Film Festival in her Balmain dress. Holland commented with three flame emojis.

Holland once again posted Zendaya to his timeline, this time with a photo of her on the red carpet for Dune, captioned with a hearts-eye emoji.

A day later, Zendaya was also promoting Dune, this time with co-star Timothée Chalamet. The pair were testing one another’s friendship knowledge for a BuzzFeed video when Chalamet was asked who Zendaya’s biggest crush is.

“Easy, Tom Holland!” Chalamet answered immediately, setting Zendaya off into a fit of giggles.

Zendaya told the outlet something similar, saying, “The equal sentiment [we both share] is just that when you really love and care about somebody, some moments or things, you wish were your own.…I think loving someone is a sacred thing and a special thing and something that you want to deal with and go through and experience and enjoy amongst the two people that love each other.”

During the London photo call for Spider-Man: No Way Home, Holland was interviewed and pointed to Zendaya, saying, “There she is—looking beautiful, might I add.”

On December 13, the Los Angeles premiere of the film included this adorable moment when Holland sees Zendaya walk in and gets stopped in his tracks. They do look stunning together on the red carpet, too.

Later that week, Zendaya posted photos of Holland as Spider-Man at two different ages, writing, “My Spider-Man, I’m so proud of you, some things never change and good thing.”

Holland and Zendaya were seen in New York City as Holland promoted his new film Uncharted. They held hands as they left their hotel together. Matching in dark tones, Zendaya wore a belted gray shirtdress while Holland wore a light-gray suit and black top. Both wore black masks amid the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.

Later that month, Holland flew to Rome to surprise Zendaya with a date at Antica Pesa in the city’s Trastevere neighborhood. The restaurant shared a photo of Zendaya and Holland with chef Francesco Panella on its Instagram.

“Thank you @tomholland2013 for coming back again to @anticapesa for your surprise night with @zendaya & friends,” he captioned the shot.

Holland also traveled to Boston to visit Zendaya as she was shooting the romantic drama The Challengers in the city, Boston.com reported. The couple were seen having a coffee day date together at Tatte on Boylston Street. Zendaya was dressed down in a white top and glasses, and in one shot shared on Instagram, was seen looking adoringly at her partner:

In early September, Zendaya celebrated her 26th birthday in Manhattan with Holland at MAMO Italian restaurant. The actress looked casual and chic in low-waisted denim jeans and a black crop top with long sleeves and a V-neck, which was held together with a few buttons in front. Zendaya dressed the outfit up a bit with suede pumps and a pair of diamond earrings and a pendant.

Holland arrived at the restaurant in a blue plaid button-down, dark teal pants, and white sneakers. They were joined by several of Zendaya’s co-stars, including her Euphoria cast mate Hunter Schafer. Zendaya’s mother Claire Stoermer was also in attendance.

Later in September, Zendaya spoke about Holland when she was interviewed by E! News just after winning an Emmy Award for her performance as Rue on Euphoria. After they asked who she texted first after winning, she replied, “Well, I didn’t have to text my mom because my mom was already there, she’s here tonight, which is very special. And I texted my boyfriend.”

Zendaya and Holland visited the Louvre in Paris, walking hand-in-hand through the famous museum’s galleries. They were both dressed casually for their day out, Zendaya wearing a large light blue blouse with her sleeves rolled up, her hair up in a bun with a few curling tendrils around her face. She wore a pair of glasses for the tour, a black bag, and carried a small camera.

Holland was in a white and black striped shirt with long sleeves and black pants, his short hair tousled. Zendaya was in the city for Paris Fashion Week, which ended on October 4.

After taking a break from social media over the summer, fans noted Holland was exploring Instagram again. A fan edit of Zendaya looking fantastic in a million outfits was popular on the algorithm, and it eventually reached her boyfriend. The clip is captioned, “just zendaya owning the camera,” and clearly he agreed because he hit the like button.

Fans noted his “heart” on the images and were thrilled to see he was as in love as ever.

Earlier that month, they made an appearance on Instagram together after Holland accompanied Zendaya on a visit to her old high school in Oakland. Pictures of the meet-and-greet were shared by her theater teacher Tavia Percia.

Neither Zendaya nor Holland attended any award season shows with each other, but during Oscars weekend, the couple was seen in London, where Holland’s family is based, and days later together at a grocery store in the city.

Fans noticed later that month that Zendaya was wearing a ring with Holland’s initials. They also noted that Holland has been wearing pants with a “Z” initial on the back pocket in sweet sartorial tributes to each other.

In May, the couple visited Venice together and were photographed getting into a private boat as they left the Gritti Palace hotel. Holland was wearing khaki pants and a white button-up with the top button open to reveal a thin gold chain. His girlfriend wore a gray body-hugging knit dress with a thigh slit under a black jacket. On her feet were matching black leather boots, and she was also wearing a gold necklace for the Italian outing. Holland got into the boat ahead of his girlfriend and she navigated it a bit more slowly.

Holland joked about his “rizz,” slang for “charisma,” during a BuzzFeed interview and expressed his gratitude for having a girlfriend.

“I'm happy and in love, so I’ve got no need for rizz,” he said. “I have no rizz whatsoever; I have limited rizz... I need you to fall in love with me, really, for it to work.”

He added, “So, long game. Probably making a movie with each other—it definitely helps when the characters are falling in love with one another; you can sort of blur the lines a little bit.”

He also shared that his girlfriend Zendaya was also his childhood celebrity crush.

“Zendaya. Easily,” he replied after they asked for names.

Holland appeared that same month in a cover story for The Hollywood Reporter, and he discussed why the couple keeps their life private. It's partly because they are “two very busy people.”

“Our relationship is something that we are incredibly protective of and we want to keep as sacred as possible,” he explained. “We don’t think that we owe it to anyone, it’s our thing, and it has nothing to do with our careers.”

He also joked about how his Spider-Man co-star sends him constant content on social media.

“She sends me too much, it's like, I can't keep up,” Holland said. “I delete my Instagram for days at a time. I download it to post and then I have to check my messages, and I'll have hundreds and hundreds and hundreds of things from her.”

On the July 3 episode of the Wondery podcast SmartLess, Holland spoke with hosts Jason Bateman, Sean Hayes, and Will Arnett about why he and Zendaya work so well.

“I’m lucky that I have someone like Zendaya in my life,” Holland said. “It’s interesting being in a romantic relationship with someone that is in the same boat as you.”

He continued, “You can share your experiences and all that sort of stuff—and that's worth its weight in gold.”

Zendaya spoke to ELLE about whether fans liking her and Holland as a couple so much makes it easier to accept the public’s interest in them.

“Parts of my life, I accept, are going to be public,” she replied. “I can’t not be a person and live my life and love the person I love. But also, I do have control over what I choose to share. It’s about protecting the peace and letting things be your own but also not being afraid to exist. You can’t hide. That’s not fun, either. I am navigating it more than ever now.”

For Zendaya’s 27th birthday on September 1, Holland shared a tribute to her on his Instagram Story. “My birthday girl 😍,” he captioned a shot of her getting ready to scuba dive.

Zendaya and Holland spent some time cuddling up with newborn puppies in early October...and Holland shared an Instagram grid post from the outing featuring both him and his girlfriend. “Puppies,” he captioned it. “🫠🥺,” Zendaya commented.

On Sunday, October 8, Zendaya and Holland were photographed out on a very PDA-heavy stroll in a West London park. Holland in particular was captured kissing Zendaya’s hand in one shot.

On January 4, Zendaya unfollowed everyone she was following on Instagram, including Holland. Holland still followed her account at the time. This led to speculation that the couple had split, though it didn’t seem personal—more like a strategic brand move.

On January 12, the Spider-Man star clarified his relationship status with co-star Zendaya, telling reporters that they are “absolutely not” split up in a video shared by TMZ.

Holland and Zendaya had their first date night of 2024. The couple was photographed holding hands in London after the Dune: Part Two premiere after-party on February 15. Both wore black ensembles, Zendaya in a stunning asymmetrical gown.

In late February, Zendaya went out of her way to bring up Holland in an interview. She complimented his charisma. The actress had been asked which Dune cast member had the most “rizz.”

“Rizz is short for charisma, right?” she started. “Everybody’s kind of got their own. I think someone who has beautiful charisma, not on the Dune cast, but I know personally, works for me, is Mr. Tom Holland. I’m more shy and kind of quiet, so it takes a little bit more to pull me out of my shell. But he’s great at just talking to people and getting to know people. You see him on talk shows and stuff like that. He’s just naturally very good at that. Whereas for me, I’ve definitely had to pull it out of me a little bit. He’s got that natural gift.”

Holland and Zendaya had a day date at the BNP Paribas Open final day in Indian Wells, California, on March 17. The couple was photographed in the stands together in their biggest public appearance together of the year so far:

Zendaya spoke a little about Holland in her Vogue interview. She praised how Holland handled overnight fame when Spider-Man: Homecoming came out in 2017. “We were both very, very young, but my career was already kind of going, and his changed overnight,” she said. “One day you’re a kid and you’re at the pub with your friends, and then the next day you’re Spider-Man. I definitely watched his life kind of change in front of him. But he handled it really beautifully.”

She also addressed Holland’s new gig in a London production of Romeo & Juliet: “[I] could not be more proud. I’m going to try to see as many shows as I possibly can.”

While Zendaya doesn’t share much about her life with Holland, she did open up about a date they had in Paris when they had wanted to go to the Louvre in October 2022. They were told “it’s already busy. You might make it worse,” but went anyway.

“It was actually fine,” Zendaya said, despite them getting attention from fans. “You just kind of get used to the fact that, Oh, I’m also one of these art pieces you’re going to take a picture of. I just gotta be totally cool with it and just live my life.” They were allowed to stay after closing time, too. “It was one of the coolest experiences ever. It was like Night at the Museum,” she recalled.

On April 25, a source told People that Holland and Zendaya’s relationship had privately become very serious. “There has been talk of marriage, and that is a reality,” the source said. Their priority is their careers for the moment, they added: “Work is important to both and that keeps them busy now.”

To celebrate Challengers’ opening weekend, Holland shared an Instagram Story with the movie’s trailer, writing, “CHALLENGERS IS OUT NOW! LET’S GOOOO!!!” and tagging his girlfriend.

A source told People during the film’s opening weekend, “They are proud of each other’s successes and totally supportive. This is a plus in their relationship making it equal. They are each caring toward the other. It’s not a case where one is caring and the other isn’t so much. They are great people and are there for the good and bad. As busy as they are, this is super important.”

Zendaya was a supportive girlfriend to Holland on May 23, as the pair was photographed leaving a press night for Holland’s Romeo and Juliet at The Duke of York’s Theatre in London.

They held hands in photos, and Zendaya dressed on theme for the event. She wore a black corset dress from Andreas Kronthaler for Vivienne Westwood’s spring/summer 2023 collection. Holland kept it more casual in a black sweater and pants.

TikToker Sonia Ali shared a video of Holland and Zendaya holding hands in London as they walked to a car. Zendaya then leaned in to kiss Holland as she got in first, and he followed.

In an interview on The Rich Roll podcast, Holland teased a bit about the next Spider-Man film and how he had shared it with his girlfriend.

“We have a creative and a pitch and a draft which is excellent,” Holland said. “It needs work but the writers are doing a great job and I read it three weeks ago and it really lit a fire in me.”

He continued, “Zendaya and I sat down and read it together and we at times were like bouncing around the living room. Like this is a real movie worthy of the fans’ respect, but there [are] a few things we need to figure out before we can get that really going. But it’s exciting and I’m really, really excited about it.”

He added that he wants to give fans “the best version of what the next chapter for Spider-Man looks like.”

“I think that’s really important and I think the creative integrity for something like that is really important,” he said. “And the studio is on board and supportive and really collaborative, and I’ve been so blown away by how welcoming they’ve been into that creative room, but we’re working now with the pedal to the metal. We’re trying to get it going as soon as possible. Things are looking great but there’s still a lot of moving pieces that need to come together for us to hit the ground running.”

On October 24, Zendaya joined Holland to celebrate the launch of his nonalcoholic beer brand, Bero. She wore a burgundy Louis Vuitton dress, which complemented his top. They held hands while leaving the event.

At the very end of October, Holland admitted on the podcast On The Menu, hosted by Samah Dada, that the last thing he “Googled” was his girlfriend’s name as a way of checking up on her since he left social media.

Dada asked about his Googling habits and Holland replied, “The last thing I Googled was actually Zendaya. I’m not on socials and I delete it when I’m not using it. So sometimes like—it’s more of a bit of an anxiety thing...I’ll check to see if everything’s good and to make sure we’re all cool. So I just give her a little Google and look through the news and I’m like, ‘she’s good.’”

Shortly before Thanksgiving, Holland shared several Instagram Stories from the couple’s night out at Foxhole bar in Boston. They enjoyed his nonalcoholic beer brand, Bero, which he tagged in the photos. He was sure to post several heart-eye emojis on his pic of Zendaya in the November 24 snaps.

On December 17, the Spider-Man star opened up on the Dish from Waitrose podcast, sharing his holiday plans with Zendaya.

“I’m going to be in America this year,” Holland said, when asked about Christmas. “I’ll be with my girlfriend’s family, which is fun.”

“I think what we’d like to start doing is, rather than like spending it with each family, each year is bring the families together,” he said. “That’s what I think we want to do next time. This time, since we’re both actors, we’re terrible at organizing things, so it hasn’t happened yet.”

He then talked about doing the cooking at home for them both.

“I’m starting to venture into a lot of vegetarian cooking,” Holland claimed. “My girlfriend’s vegetarian. So, I’ve been in Boston these past few weeks, and she’s been working, so I’ve been doing a lot of the dinners, and they haven’t been great.”

He added, “I actually love Zendaya’s spicy vodka fusilli thingamagigy. And it is delicious.”

The actor explained a bit more about their dynamic and how it works for them after all these years.

“I think that’s where Zendaya and I have been such a strong couple, as in the spirit of being able to relate with one another on something that is very, very unique,” he shared. “And I think it’s just relying on the people around you. It’s about being a little bit more organized knowing where you want to go, and there are restaurants that have little back rooms and stuff where you can have a more private night. But at the end of the day, it’s no hardship.”

On the day of the episode’s release, the couple were spotted in a Nordstrom in pics shared by TMZ. They were dressed casually for the outing in Topanga Mall at Canoga Park and Zendaya had her dog on a leash.

Men’s Health published a new interview with Holland on January 2. In the piece, the star revealed why he doesn’t walk red carpets with Zendaya during her premieres: “Because it’s not my moment, it’s her moment, and if we go together, it’s about us.”

He also shared what he plans to do in his career once he has a family someday. “When I have kids, you will not see me in movies anymore,” he said. “[It’ll just be] golf and dad. And I will just disappear off the face of the earth.”

At the Golden Globes on January 5, Zendaya sparked rumors she and Holland could be engaged when she debuted a diamond ring on her left ring finger that wasn’t from Bulgari like her other jewelry.

The morning after, TMZ reported that Zendaya and Holland are indeed engaged. Holland proposed “in one of Zendaya’s family homes in the United States” between Christmas and New Year’s, sources close to the couple said. It was a “very romantic” and “intimate” proposal between just them.

On January 6, she attended a special screening of Challengers wearing the ring.

A few days later, Holland’s father, Dominic, released more details about the engagement in a Patreon blog post. The English actor and author shared in his post that he knows some of the people following him are doing so to glean more details about the celebrity couple. Dominic wrote it “amuses” him, but he was happy to have something to report this time.

“The big news this week is a good example of just such an opportunity for me—are they aren’t they engaged?” he wrote. “Zendaya wearing a ring and Tom nowhere to be seen adding to the intrigue.”

Dominic then stated that he would not be “adding anything new and juicy like a date, venue, guest list,” but he would be sharing “the different approaches of father and son to proposing marriage.”

“Tom, as you know by now was very incredibly well prepared. He had purchased a ring. He had spoken with her father and gained permission to propose to his daughter,” Dominic explained. “Tom had everything planned out… When, where, how, what to say, what to wear.”

Dominic shared that when he proposed to his son’s mom, Nikki, it was “nothing like my eldest son who has obviously watched all the slushy movies because growing up I never saw him reading a book.”

He added, “For most blokes, the stress of purchasing an engagement ring is being able to afford it. I suspect that this was the least of Tom’s worries, more concerned with the stone, [its] size and clarity, its housing, which jeweler.”

The Spider-Man star’s dad mentioned how he does not “envy those who are gawped at wherever they go,” adding, “I do fret that their combined stardom will amplify their spotlight and the commensurate demands on them and yet they continually confound me by handling everything with aplomb.”

He continued, “And even though show business is a messy place for relationships and particularly so for famous couples as they crash and burn in public and are too numerous to mention… I am completely confident they will make a successful union.”

In an interview, Spider-Man co-star Jacob Batalon, who plays Peter Parker’s best friend Ned Leeds in the films, was jokingly asked if they’d be one another’s best man at their respective weddings.

Laughing, Batalon replied, “Maybe, you know, I really—he’s a lot to deal with, so probably not.”

On April 8, Zendaya’s longtime stylist and creative director, Law Roach, shared that the actress and Holland are in no rush to tie the knot. Roach told E! that “of course,” he’ll be involved in dressing Zendaya on her big day.

But “it’s far away,” he revealed to the outlet at the Fashion Trust Awards. “They’re both doing a bunch of movies this year, and there’s a lot of premieres next year so you’ll see a lot of red carpets.” He teased, “I’m resting up for 2026.”

On April 26, Holland was photographed stopping by the Euphoria set in Los Angeles to visit Zendaya, who was filming season 3 of the HBO hit. He was joined by Zendaya’s miniature schnauzer, Noon, whom he carried under one arm. The couple was both in comfortable looks, with Holland wearing a yellow sweatshirt and wide-legged black pants. He had on a red baseball cap with his nonalcoholic beer brand Bero’s logo on it.

Zendaya was holding a green drink and a bunch of snacks during her break, and was wearing brown sweatpants, a cream hoodie, and fuzzy ankle booties over thick socks. She had her hair down in loose curls, some tucked into her top. The pair reportedly hung out in Zendaya’s trailer for a bit before Holland headed home with the puppy.

In an interview with GQ, Holland was asked about his favorite Wimbledon looks.

“Zendaya wore that Ralph Lauren suit a couple of years ago,” he said. “She just looked so beautiful and so at home. It meant so much to me for her to be in a place that I call home and look like such a part of our community.”

Zendaya actually wore two Ralph Lauren suits to Wimbledon in July 2024. The first, worn on day 13, was a khaki blazer over a light blue button-down shirt with dark-wash oversize denim pants. She accessorized with a knit blue and white striped tie and large pearl earrings.

The second look, which she wore the following day, was a white blazer over a blue and white striped button-down shirt, and she topped it off with another knit blue tie.

That same month, Zendaya’s longtime stylist, Law Roach, revealed the couple is holding off on planning their wedding despite getting engaged over six months ago.

“The process hasn’t even started yet,” he told E! at the Las Culturistas Culture Awards’ red carpet last month. “Zendaya is working on so many movies. She’s now filming the next iteration of Dune [Part Three in Hungary], so she’s away doing that. It’s so many movies, so we have time. We have a lot of time.” He added that the actress will be “a secret bride,” as the pair would like to keep their nuptials private.

The couple began production on Spider-Man: Brand New Day and were seen in London throughout August. The Marvel film was shot in Glasgow, but Holland and Zendaya recently enjoyed some downtime in London’s Richmond Park.

On August 7, the engaged couple was spotted again, when Zendaya visited Holland on set at the Brookwood Cemetery in Surrey, England. He was reportedly filming an emotional scene at the gravesite of Peter Parker’s Aunt May (played by Marisa Tomei).

More pictures of Zendaya and Holland started circulating on social media, showing the pair with their dog, Noon. Holland was wearing a number of different outfits, some of which appear to be costumes, but Zendaya was pictured in an off-white cardigan over a pale yellow button-down shirt. She paired it with wide-legged jeans and brown loafers. Her hair was in a loose updo with soft curls around her face. In some pictures, her five-carat engagement ring could be seen as she raised her hand to her face. In one photo, he appears to lean against her in a sweet moment of PDA.

On September 20, the couple stepped out for a rare public appearance in support of Holland’s nonprofit, The Brothers Trust. The actor and his family hosted a fundraising event for the organization at Christie’s London auction house. Holland dressed in a classic tuxedo while Zendaya wore a black Valentino minidress with a wide ruffle detail, tights, and a pair of black pumps.

Holland, who was recovering from a head injury suffered on the set of Spider-Man: Brand New Day, shared a highlight reel from the gathering. “What a night! Another huge success. The Brothers Trust means more to me than I could possibly say and I have to say a huge thank you to my Mum and her wonderful friends for putting on another incredible night. Raising money for fantastic causes and having fun doing it!” he wrote. “I’m sorry I had to leave early but I’m feeling better and on the mend. A huge thanks to my Dad for taking over after I left. The show got considerably funnier 😂.”

Shortly after, on September 29, Holland had the internet abuzz after an X user posted a clip of the actor participating in a panel discussion to promote his nonalcoholic beer brand, Bero. During the chat, the moderator referred to Zendaya as Holland’s “girlfriend,” which the husband-to-be kindly corrected, saying, “Fiancée.” The moment originally happened in April at the Beverage Forum, a gathering for executives in the beverage industry, but the full panel discussion was posted on YouTube on September 3. This was seemingly the first time Holland had publicly confirmed the engagement news.

Zendaya and Holland made a rare public appearance at “The Traitors: Live Experience,” in London, enjoying a family game night with Tom’s parents, siblings, and close friends. The Spider-Man star’s brother, Sam Holland, shared a glimpse of the December 21 gathering on Instagram, highlighting a sweet moment of the engaged couple posing with his parents.

While Zendaya wore a bobbed hairstyle and a gray sweater, Tom dressed in a light jacket layered over a burgundy top. “My traitor twin 😂,” Sam captioned his recap, referring to his twin brother, Harry. “Had a great time at @thetraitorslive yesterday. You can’t trust anyone when you enter the round table… not even family 🧐.”

Zendaya was photographed wearing a gold band on her left ring finger instead of her engagement ring on February 18, sparking questions about her relationship status with Holland. In July, her stylist, Roach, had told E! that when the pair do get married, Zendaya would be “a secret bride.”

On March 16, Zendaya addressed viral AI-generated wedding photos of her and Holland during an appearance on Jimmy Kimmel Live!. When asked about rumors that the two had secretly tied the knot, she responded, “Really? I haven’t seen any of that.”

She then clarified that the widely circulated images were not real, saying, “Many people have been fooled by them. While I was, like, just out and about in real life, and people were like, ‘Oh my god, your wedding photos are gorgeous.’ And I was like, ‘Babe, they’re AI.’”

Four days later on March 20, the couple was photographed holding hands in Los Angeles. The actress was in a long white skirt and long-sleeve black shirt. Holland wore a striped T-shirt and navy slacks.

On March 21, Holland made a rare public post on Instagram to celebrate Zendaya’s new film, The Drama, in which she stars with Robert Pattinson. The actor shared the trailer, writing in the caption, “I honestly couldn’t be more excited for you to see this movie and believe me when I say it’s gonna floor you. Get your tickets now!”

On April 25, the couple was photographed out in Los Angeles with their In-N-Out bag. Holland appeared to be carrying Zendaya’s bag of fast food and possibly her black purse over one shoulder as they walked through the parking lot. She was wearing white pants with a long-sleeve black shirt and carrying a black sweater. Holland wore black jeans, a white and green shirt, and a baseball cap.

In her ELLE summer 2026 cover story, Zendaya opened up about working alongside Holland again on Spider-Man: Brand New Day, as well as what it was like to watch Holland film The Odyssey. “I could have cried, I was so proud,” she said of seeing Holland on set for the Christopher Nolan-directed film. She added that reuniting on Spider-Man felt especially meaningful: “And then Spider-Man was a dream; I get to go to work every day with my best friend, the person that I love. We bring our dogs to work; it’s like a family affair. We grew up on those movies! It’s like coming home.”

The interview also revealed that the couple recently adopted another dog together while visiting Zendaya’s hometown of Oakland. “Logistically, it wasn’t probably the smartest idea,” Zendaya said. “But emotionally, it was. He’s a wonderful addition to our family. I saw his little face and I was like, ‘I can’t leave you behind.’”

When asked about speculation surrounding their relationship status after she was photographed wearing a gold band on her ring finger, Zendaya declined to comment directly.

On June 15, Holland and Zendaya made their first official red carpet appearance together since 2021 at the Spider-Man: Brand New Day photo-call in Madrid.

For the event, Holland wore a black jacket and trousers layered over a bright red shirt and coordinating tie. Zendaya opted for a strapless black Christian Cowan dress featuring a dramatic fringe-trimmed skirt paired with pointed-toe pumps.

The couple shared a few affectionate moments while posing for photographers. They exchanged smiles, looked at each other, and held hands.

A day later, Esquire UK released its cover story with Holland. In his interview, Holland confirmed that he and Zendaya had gotten married while discussing the fake AI photos that came out of their wedding in March. Holland spoke about his grandmother contacting him about them. When asked if he had to have similar conversations with other family members, he replied, “No, because they were all there.” The reporter told him that he hadn’t been aware they were already married. Holland replied, “That’s all you’ll get on that.”

The actor spoke glowingly about Zendaya though, telling the outlet, “Our business can present very stressful situations and it’s really nice to have a bedrock of a relationship that will stand the test of time. We can support each other in ways that only we can, because only we understand really what it’s like to live this life, and I think that is such a luxury, because I just don’t understand how I would be able to have anything like that with anyone else. So, for me, I found my person. She’s my best friend, and I’m the happiest I ever have been when I’m with her, but I also have never felt so supported and safe, ever. Period.”

Holland and Zendaya continued their Spider-Man: Brand New Day press tour with several appearances across Europe. On June 17, they posed together at a photocall in Amsterdam. Holland wore a navy suit with a striped tie, while Zendaya paired a black high-neck top with a bright red miniskirt and white pumps.

On June 22, the couple stepped out in Berlin. For the first event of the day, Holland opted for a tan jacket layered over a light shirt and jeans, while Zendaya wore a red varsity-inspired Coach top with a checked midi skirt.

Later, they attended another Spider-Man: Brand New Day event in the city. Holland wore a dark suit styled with a red shirt and matching tie, while Zendaya chose a black two-piece ensemble featuring a cropped top and a floor-length skirt with a dramatic train.

On June 24, Holland shared photos from the Spider-Man: Brand New Day press tour stop in Rome on Instagram, captioning the post, “When in Rome! Spider-Man Brand New Day.”

The images showed him and Zendaya walking hand in hand and smiling together. For the event, Holland wore a burgundy Louis Vuitton suit with a coordinating shirt and tie, while Zendaya opted for a shimmering archival Giorgio Armani dress featuring an intricate web-inspired design. Zendaya reposted Holland’s Instagram to her own Instagram Story.

While promoting The Odyssey, Holland and Zendaya shared several new details about supporting each other during its filming.

In a People interview on July 15, Holland recalled discussing the role of Telemachus with Zendaya after learning that its production schedule would overlap with Spider-Man: Brand New Day. He said, “To be honest, when I got home after our meeting, I sat down with Z and was like, ‘I’ve been offered this movie.’ And she was like, ‘By who?’ And I was like, ‘It’s the big one.’ And she was like, ‘Chris?’ I was like, ‘Yeah, it’s Chris Nolan.’”

“And then we had Spider-Man that was literally scheduled to go the same day that we would start shooting,” he continued. “Z said, ‘I’ll leave you if you don’t do The Odyssey.’”

Zendaya also revealed that Holland was the one who told her Christopher Nolan wanted her to play Athena. “He was...allowed to be the one to tell me, and that was really special,” she told the Associated Press. “I was already on cloud nine. The fact that I was even got to be involved as well was like just this cherry on top.”

At the film’s New York premiere on July 14, Zendaya told Extra that Holland’s presence helped calm her nerves on her first day of filming. “You know, some locations he wasn’t at, but he was on my first day, which I was very grateful for, because as you can imagine, something like this is quite a daunting task,” she said. “It’s the scale, the scope, it’s absolutely extraordinary. So walking onto a Chris Nolan set for the first time is no small feat, so I was happy to have some support.”

Holland was equally enthusiastic about sharing the experience with her. “I mean, it’s awesome,” he told the outlet. “We still, to this day, cannot believe we got to go through this together and experience this epic movie on the same set, on the same days. You know, she’s fantastic in the film. She had a really tough job. I think when you see the movie and you see what she has to do, it’s really difficult, and as always, she nailed it.”

After finishing their The Odyssey press tour, the couple resumed engagements for Spider-Man: Brand New Day. During an interview in Mexico, Zendaya grabbed Holland’s hand when a journalist spoke about her appreciation for their dynamic as co-workers:

Holland also went viral when he failed to recognize Zendaya’s song lyrics in a different interview:

Zendaya and Holland’s film Spider-Man: Brand New Day had a huge opening weekend, earning $360 million in its domestic debut—and breaking the record for biggest opening weekend previously held by Avengers: Endgame. On August 3, Kevin Feige, president of Marvel Studios, spoke to Variety about the couple’s success—and their plans following the press tour for the film.

Feige confirmed that Holland will do another Spider-Man film. “There are always plans,” he said. “But right now, he’s going to rest after that global tour. He and Zendaya are going to take a good and restful victory lap, which they very much deserve.”

On November 15, Zendaya and Holland attended the Governors Awards in Los Angeles. Although the couple posed separately on the red carpet, they were later spotted together inside the event.

Zendaya wore a strapless, bronze-colored Giles Deacon gown with a textured finish and sculptural detailing at the hips. Holland opted for a black double-breasted tuxedo with a white shirt and black bow tie.

#6631. Robert Pattinson Is the James Bond Millennials Deserve

The 40-year-old actor has been chosen to become the seventh James Bond in film, following in the footsteps of Daniel Craig

The news is finally out: Robert Pattinson is the next James Bond. After weeks of speculation and an almost algorithmic audition process that played out on our social feeds, Pattinson has triumphed over a list of peers that reportedly included Nicholas Hoult, Callum Turner, and Josh O’Connor.

For the last few weeks, I’ve watched the rolling news coverage of the casting process with trepidation, because the concept of a machismo-fueled, womanizing killing machine feels tired and outdated in 2026. But that’s exactly why the choice of Pattinson made me breathe a sigh of relief. Since breaking out in the 2000s,Pattinson’s career has been defined by his willingness to subvert traditional masculine archetypes, crafting them instead into slightly twisted leading-man roles. From his starring role in 2022’s The Batman to the 2026 rom-com The Drama and most recently the disturbing Oscar-tipped biopic Primetime, he has often looked for ways to subvert our expectations of the classic leading man. If there’s one actor who just might be able to make 007 feel aspirational and relevant again, it’s him.

From the beginning, Pattinson, who first emerged as a teen icon in the Twilight movies, has represented a counter-argument to traditional, protein-based masculinity. “Team Edward” and “Team Jacob,” the franchise’s central romantic rivalry (and marketing ploy), offered two very different visions of male desirability. Jacob, played by Taylor Lautner, was part man, part wolf, and was muscular, physically imposing, and (thankfully) almost always shirtless, which today draws more of a visual parallel with the sort of hypermasculinity that has flourished in online gym-bro culture and the so-called “manosphere.” And then there was Edward, Pattinson’s pale, brooding vampire who was more sensitive and emotionally tortured. With the selection of a new Bond, it feels like we’re once again seeing this masculine power struggle play out—and again, it’s Pattinson who has come out on top.

In the packed field of chiseled, handsome, talented actors who were vying for this role, whoever snagged it was always going to have his work cut out. As an archetype, 007 is a relic of generations gone by. The flashy gadgets, the signature martini, the expensive cars, and the ability to charm almost any woman belong to a very particular, nostalgic vision of masculinity. Through a more contemporary lens, Bond is the ultimate masculine drag act: an exaggerated, prop-heavy performance that is just as likely to be viewed as regressive and cliché.

We see the same trend in Bond’s dwindling romantic appeal. In our grandparents’ generation, when the character was at peak aspiration, a man arriving in a nice suit, carrying flowers, and driving a flashy car was considered a catch. But today, the dynamics have changed. I recently read The Project, the debut novel by British Vogue columnist Annie Lord, where she makes the observation that many of the most common dating “icks” now stem from men trying too hard: putting themselves out there too much, making an overt display of their interest, or seeming too confident. Lord notes that we’ve become accustomed to viewing these qualities as undesirable or embarrassing, which draws clear parallels with Bond, whose entire appeal has rested on this sort of performance. The spy’s extravagance and his carefully cultivated image were once what made him attractive, but can you imagine going on a date with a guy who seriously asks for his martini to be “shaken, not stirred”? You’d probably tell your group chat about it and endlessly mock him.

Looking more widely, there is also the question of whether the Bond franchise’s particular type of escapism can still work in the fraught world we’re currently living in. The franchise once offered a fantastical vision of evil, with megalomaniacs plotting world domination in ways that felt almost comically removed from reality. (Remember Bond’s “invisible” car in 2002’s Die Another Day?) But now, the real world feels uncomfortably close to that fantasy. Billionaires wield the kind of influence once reserved for nation-states, and the increasingly overt relationship between money and power makes it harder to distinguish the Bond villain caricature from what we’re encountering in day-to-day life.

Part of the reason Pattinson landed this role, I suspect, is that he already has experience in navigating nostalgic expectations and present-day anxieties. In The Batman, for example, he proved his ability to bring new dimensions to an old-school character with his tortured take on Bruce Wayne. And as a versatile actor who can move between action blockbusters, rom-coms, and critically acclaimed projects like Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey, he has the star power and the credibility to give Bond a millennial makeover.

It’s worth saying that during Daniel Craig’s tenure as Bond, considerable effort was made to turn Bond into a deeper, more considered character. Craig’s films explored Bond’s childhood trauma and alcohol dependence, and they also introduced female characters who were more than just a sidekick or a throwaway romantic interest. But in the five years since Craig departed, a loud and unrepentant misogyny has taken hold in corners of the internet. And from the Epstein files to the Cornell University rape allegations and, most recently, the conviction of Russell Brand, so many stories come back to the central issue of toxic masculinity.

The wider conversation about male behavior has made casting the next Bond feel strangely high-stakes, which is probably why every screen test seemed to be leaked and endlessly dissected online. And it’s also why I’m relieved that they’ve picked an actor who might be able to make Bond a little more strange. Pattinson presents the opportunity to take Bond in a different direction—one that finally frees the character from the fantasies of the past.

#6630. Sausage Stuffing Recipe

This sausage stuffing has everything you want on your Thanksgiving plate: crisp, craggy edges, a plush, savory center, and plenty of browned sausage throughout. Torn pieces of country-style bread soak up the broth and eggs without falling apart, turning golden and crunchy on top while staying tender underneath.

Breakfast sausage does much of the heavy lifting. Once browned, its drippings join plenty of butter to cook the onions, celery, and garlic. Fresh sage, parsley, and thyme bring balance, while optional fennel seeds add a little extra aromatic punch.

Uncooked pork breakfast sausage is the first choice. Typically seasoned with sage and black pepper, it brings familiar Thanksgiving flavors and plenty of richness. For some heat, choose spicy breakfast sausage. If you can't find the packaged kind or want to avoid pork, try making your own with our breakfast sausage recipe, using ground dark-meat turkey in place of pork.

This stuffing relies on the fat from breakfast sausage for its flavor. Want a vegetarian version? Our Simple-Is-Best Stuffing is a long-standing reader favorite and was the inspiration for this version; use that recipe with vegetable broth for a meat-free stuffing.

What’s the best bread for sausage stuffing?

Look for a sturdy country-style white loaf or sourdough with a relatively thin crust. Avoid soft sandwich bread, which can turn mushy, and very crusty artisan loaves, which won’t absorb the broth as readily. Even if your bread is a day or two old, don’t skip drying it in the oven—that’s what helps the stuffing hold its shape.

Can I make sausage stuffing ahead of time?

You can dry the bread a day ahead and store it loosely covered at room temperature. For more ways to get ahead of Thanksgiving, including cooking, refrigerating, and reheating stuffing, see our make-ahead stuffing guide.

Place a rack in middle of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease a 13x9" baking dish with unsalted butter. Arrange one 1–1¼-lb. loaf country-style white bread, torn into 1" pieces, in a single layer on a large rimmed baking sheet and bake until dried out and golden around the edges, 30–40 minutes. Let cool.

Meanwhile, melt 2 Tbsp. unsalted butter in a large Dutch oven or other heavy pot over medium-high heat. Cook 1 lb. breakfast sausage, casings removed if needed, stirring and breaking into small pieces, until well browned and cooked through, 8–10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a small plate, leaving fat behind.

Reduce dial to medium heat and add remaining 8 Tbsp. unsalted butter to fat in pot; heat until melted. Cook 2 medium onions, finely chopped, 6 celery stalks, finely chopped, 8 garlic cloves, coarsely chopped, 1 Tbsp. Diamond Crystal or 1¾ tsp. Morton kosher salt, and 1 tsp. fennel seeds (if using), stirring occasionally, until onions are softened and golden around the edges, 12–15 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth or vegetable broth along with sausage, ½ cup (packed) coarsely chopped parsley, 2 Tbsp. finely chopped sage, 2 Tbsp. finely chopped thyme, and ½ tsp. freshly ground pepper.

Whisk 3 large eggs and remaining 1 cup low-sodium chicken broth or vegetable broth in a small bowl to combine, then stir into pot (don’t worry, eggs won’t scramble). Add bread to pot and toss gently to combine. Let sit, tossing occasionally, until liquid is almost completely absorbed, about 10 minutes.

Transfer stuffing to prepared dish (don’t pack or press down) and cover loosely with foil. Place dish on a clean large rimmed baking sheet and bake until stuffing is hot throughout (an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should register 160°), 35–45 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 400° and remove foil (no need to remove stuffing from oven while heat increases). Continue to bake until stuffing is light golden brown on top, 25–30 minutes longer.

Do Ahead: Bread can be baked 1 day ahead; store loosely covered at room temperature. Stuffing can be assembled 1 day ahead; cover and chill. Bring to room temperature before baking.

Editor’s note: This sausage stuffing recipe was first printed in our November 2023 issue; it has been updated for style. Head this way for more of our favorite Thanksgiving side dishes →

#6629. Robert Pattinson’s James Bond Announcement Is Already Brewing Some Watch Drama

Throughout the years-long process of casting the new James Bond, I tried to follow the watches to an answer. When Aaron Taylor-Johnson joined the Omega family in May 2025, it felt like watching the 007 Vatican spit white smoke from its steeple. Just this past weekend, fans were still pinning red strings on their bulletin boards between Jack Lowden and the MI6 superspy when images resurfaced of the Slow Horses star wearing Omega. Since 1995’s Goldeneye, Bond has been an Omega man—a relationship later canonized in one of cinema’s most iconic line readings, when Daniel Craig confirmed his brand of choice in three stretched-out syllables: Oh-Mee-Guh.

If, like me, you were only basing your predictions on what the reported pool of potential Bonds wore on their wrists, Robert Pattinson would have been an easy name to cross off. The newly announced 007 only signed on as an ambassador for the Swiss luxury brand Jaeger-LeCoultre two short months ago! When I interviewed Pattinson about the appointment over the summer, he was effusive about his new partner: “I very rarely even wear watches, but when I tried it on, I was like, ‘That’s my favorite watch.’ I wanted to just buy it.”

Now, in addition to juggling his other iconic role as Batman, Pattinson will presumably need to balance his existing commitment to JLC with his new gig’s long-held ties to Omega. (Reps for both brands did not immediately respond to requests for comment, though JLC conspicuously posted a photo of Pattinson on Instagram a few hours after the announcement.)

During our conversation earlier this summer, Pattinson revealed what he looks for in a watch. He caught the collecting bug in March, when he wore JLC’s Master Control Chronometre Perpetual Calendar to the Oscars afterparties. “All these other actors with their fancy watches on asked me, ‘Hey, what are you wearing?’” Pattinson recalls. “It was one of those moments where I’m like, ‘It’s kind of badass having this thing on.’”

If it’s attention-grabbing badass watches Pattinson is after, he’s in good hands with Omega. The brand is best known for supplying the watches Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin wore when they landed on the moon in 1969. Omega has been happy to create special versions of the Speedmaster for its current partners to dial up its profile. And, of course, the Swiss house continues to expand its Bond-inspired offerings: The maker recently added a “Spectre” version of the Seamaster, 007’s preferred model, to the lineup. And whenever Omega needs to drum up buzz around soon-to-be-released models, they tend to show up on former Bond Craig’s wrists during public appearances.

Speculators trying to pin down the next Bond would have had better luck if they’d read some less recent watch tea leaves. Back in 2020, Christopher Nolan released Tenet, his inscrutable but enthralling time-warp thriller in which Pattinson plays a mysterious, dapper, and charming spy involved in a high-stakes mission to save the world—about as good a preview of what the 40-year-old actor will look like as 007 as you’ll find in his filmography. And the watch on his wrist in that flick? An Omega.

#6628. “C’est Bow!”; Lea Seydoux Wore the Night’s Best Dress at the 2026 Governors Awards

Last night, the 2026 Governors Awards served as the official kickoff to the 2027 awards season—and all of Hollywood’s finest came out for the cinematic occasion. One such well-clad star in attendance was the French actor Léa Seydoux, who hit the red carpet in a red, crêpe jersey off-the-shoulder gown by Louis Vuitton, complete with an oversized satin bow at the back. “It was a night to celebrate the people who make us love cinema,” says Seydoux of attending the ceremony. “It's about the craft—the people behind the films. That means a lot to me.”

The star herself has been garnering buzz for her new film, Marie Kreutzer’s Gentle Monster, which releases this week. In the dark drama, Seydoux portrays a renowned concert pianist whose life is turned upside down after her husband is arrested for possessing child sexual abuse material. “Marie Kreutzer is a fearless director, and she trusted me with something very delicate,” says Seydoux. “Honestly, at first I was afraid of the subject. But I think when you are afraid, it means maybe you have to do it.” The film served up another challenge for Seydoux, too: It marked her first time having to sing in a project. “It was like jumping from a cliff,” says Seydoux. “And to finally work with Catherine Deneuve—it was a dream!”

Last look. We kept the hair and makeup very simple—the bob, a red lip—and we let the dress speak.

Given that she has a buzzy new film everyone is talking about, it only made sense that Seydoux went into full-on movie star mode at the Governors Awards last night. She wanted a look that channeled classic Hollywood glamour—and who better to do it custom than Vuitton, who Seydoux has worked with for a decade now. “It’s always like coming home,” says Seydoux of collaborating with the French label. “I wanted something a bit old Hollywood, but clean and modern. And Red, because it’s a night for the cinema: It's joyful, confident, and not shy.”

Though the powerful color made a statement on its own, Seydoux was also drawn to the striking silhouette of her Vuitton look—courtesy of that big bow. Forget making an entrance, this was a dress that made an exit. “I liked that from the front it's simple, and then when you see the back, there is a surprise,” says Seydoux. “The front of the dress is very pure, just the shape and the satin on the shoulders. And then you turn, and there is this huge bow with the train. It's a bit theatrical, a bit playful—I love it.” She accessorized with the label’s high jewelry pieces.

C'est bow. I think this is my style—quite minimal, but with one strong idea.

It made for one of the night’s most memorable fashion serves—and the good news is Seydoux has plenty more red carpets to hit in the busy awards season ahead. Gentle Monster hits Netflix on Wednesday, but she also has other projects coming up. “I'm very excited for people to see it,” she says. “There is also The Unknown from Arthur Harari, with Neon. And in February, I will be president of the César [Awards], which is a big honor for me.”

In between all of the premieres and red carpets, however, Seydoux will be trying to squeeze in a little “me time” this fall—back in her native City of Light, of course. “In between, I try to stay home in Paris with my family as much as I can,” she says. “For me this balance is very important.” One can’t be serving glamour 24/7—even stars need a little break.

Below, see more photos from inside Seydoux’s 2026 Governors Awards.

While Chalamet and Jenner are an unexpected couple to fans, they’ve been together for years. Kylie is truly his biggest fan. She would clear her schedule to attend awards and premieres with him. She couldn’t be more supportive of his career.”

On April 18, a source told People that the couple is now “very serious” after they faced a more challenging start to the year.

“With the awards season and premieres, earlier this year was intense for their relationship,” the insider explained. “But they are making it work. Kylie is truly his biggest fan. She would clear her schedule to attend awards and premieres with him. She couldn’t be more supportive of his career.”

A few days later, Chalamet’s mom, Nicole Flender, publicly commented on Jenner in a Curbed interview, saying, “I have to say she’s lovely. She’s very nice to me.” She also revealed that Chalamet recently bought an $11 million house in Beverly Hills.

On April 24, a source told Entertainment Tonight that the two stars are enjoying the moment and are hopeful about their long-term potential. “[They’re] happy with where things are and focused on spending time together,” the insider said. “They don’t put pressure on their relationship, but everything is going really well, and they could see themselves taking things to the next level someday.”

The source said: “Timothée’s family is supportive of him and his relationship with Kylie. They appreciate how loving and caring Kylie is. They want him to succeed and be happy in every way, including with the partner he chooses to be with.”⁠

Chalamet is “close” to Jenner’s kids, and “he feels lucky to be able to share a bond with them and is also respectful of her co-parenting relationship with Travis.” ⁠

On May 1, Jenner and Chalamet were photographed at Crypto.com Arena, taking in the Los Angeles Lakers game against the Minnesota Timberwolves. They were again enjoying some PDA as they took in the basketball game.

On Friday, May 3, they were reportedly enjoying a party night at Miami club E11even, a popular celebrity hotspot in the city.

On May 7, Chalamet and Jenner finally made their red carpet debut at the 70th David di Donatello Awards in Rome. That night, Chalamet won the David Award for Cinematic Excellence.

A few days later, designer Haider Ackermann shared a photo on Instagram in which he is FaceTiming with the couple as they got ready for the night out. In the screenshot, Jenner appears to be running a lint roller across Chalamet’s suit, a black velvet ensemble by Tom Ford. He had a white flower in his lapel and is smiling broadly. Ackermann captioned the post, “TEAMWORK – Miss K, you’re hired!! I Rome May 7th. BROTHER elegantly in TOM FORD receiving the 70th David Di Donatello Award. PROUD AS ALWAYS.”

On May 21, a source spoke to Entertainment Tonight about Jenner’s hope for a serious, long-term future with Chalamet. “Kylie thinks Timothée is so great with her kids, and she has told her closest friends that she would love to have another baby with him some day,” the insider said.

They added that Jenner is “so in love with Timothée. She loves learning about his world and supporting him whenever she can.”

On May 29, they were seen at a Knicks game at Madison Square Garden.

On July 1, Jenner started following Chalamet on Instagram. Jenner met up with Chalamet in Saint-Tropez before he began filming Dune: Messiah in Prague. The couple was photographed in the French Riviera city on July 5, holding hands as they walked along Shellona Beach. Jenner wore a cream and black striped dress, while Chalamet stood out in a green bandana, Nike baseball cap, and green jersey.

Jenner liked her boyfriend’s Instagram about his Marty Supreme trailer, which he shared on August 12. Fans wondered about their relationship status after Jenner’s recent Instagram Stories featured breakup songs “Lover, You Should’ve Come Over” by Jeff Buckley and “Crying, Laughing, Loving, Lying” by Labi Saffre. Chalamet had been shooting Dune: Part Three in Hungary.

A source speaking to People on August 15 said that the couple was solid and were simply being kept apart by Chalamet’s shooting schedule.

“They haven’t seen each other for a few weeks only because Timothée’s been filming Dune in a studio in Budapest, and Kylie’s been working too,” the source explained. “She visited him in July."

They added, “But even though Kylie has a private jet, the flight is still 12 hours. She’s a mom and she works as well. She has a lot of responsibilities in L.A. Timothée’s schedule is grueling, with very little downtime. They’re making it work though. They FaceTime most days. They miss each other and are totally fine.”

A second source shared that Chalamet will head from Budapest to Jordan and Abu Dhabi.

On October 6, Jenner joined Chalamet at the New York Film Festival premiere of his upcoming film Marty Supreme. NYFF’s social media account shared a photo of the couple backstage. The couple later attended the premiere’s after-party at the Waverly Inn, wearing matching black leather outfits.

Two days later, they went to a baseball game between the New York Yankees and the Toronto Blue Jays at Yankee Stadium. For the rare public date night, Jenner wore a black and navy-blue Marty Supreme hoodie, and he wore a black and navy Yankees bomber jacket.

In an interview with Vogue, Chalamet commented on his relationship by not commenting about it. “And I don’t say that with any fear, I just don’t have anything to say,” he told the magazine.

He did discuss both marriage and children, starting with noting the relationship status of his Dune co-stars, saying, “Zendaya is engaged. Anya [Tayor-Joy] is married.”

He also claimed that “procreation is the reason we’re here,” per Vogue.

The actor said he watched an interview with a friend where a childfree person was “bragging about not having kids and how much time it afforded them to do other stuff.” He said their reaction was “like, holy shit. Oh my God. Bleak.”

Which he joked meant that fatherhood “could be on the radar.”

Daily Mail claimed Chalamet and Jenner had split after a month out of the spotlight. Jenner hopped onto Instagram to like her boyfriend’s recent posts in response.

Sources speaking to People refuted the rumors, saying they were doing well. “They’re great,” one source said, adding that they make “an effort to see each other every few weeks. He has a few days off for the holidays so they’re making plans.”

A second source added, “Timothée talked about Kylie all the time while filming Marty Supreme. She even flew out to visit him on set in NYC. They also met up in London while he was shooting Dune. They’re really in love.”

TMZ also confirmed they were still dating.

A source told People that Chalamet would spend Thanksgiving break with Jenner after several months filming.

“Kylie’s very excited that he’s been back in L.A.,” said the insider. “She’s happy to have some special time with him before he returns to filming.”

The couple plans to celebrate “with her family next week in L.A., but he’s also spending time with his family before he has to return to the Dune set.”

The source continued, “He started filming in Budapest, in July, and they’ve seen each other as much as they can. Kylie’s been flying back and forth every few weeks. Despite the distance, they’ve stayed close. They’ve been making it work.”

The couple attended the Los Angeles premiere of Chalamet’s new film Marty Supreme in custom matching orange Chrome Hearts looks. Chalamet wore a leather suit, Timberland boots, and a black ping-pong paddle side bag. Jenner wore a long gown with side cutouts, a plunging neckline, and pumps.

Chalamet released a song with rapper EsDeeKid titled “4 Raws Remix.” In the song, he references Jenner.

“It’s Timothée Chalamet chillin’, tryin’ to stack $100 million / Girl got a billion / What the fuck, what a wonderful feeling,” Chalamet raps. “My life is an opera, look at the Oscars, look at the groupies, look at the movies.”

A source told People on New Year’s Eve that the couple intends to spend the holiday together and also has a “trip planned.” The insider explained, “They are making their careers work and making their relationship work at the same time."

The insider added: “It’s been special for Kylie to have Timothée in Los Angeles more in December. She traveled to Budapest several times in the fall when he was busy working. They spent a lot of time apart, but the past few weeks have made up for it. Still, it’s not the easiest relationship. They are both incredibly focused on their careers and ambitious. She’s running a massive business and raising her kids. He’s super focused on being the best at what he does.”

Jenner “loves [his work ethic],” the source continued, adding that she would “never date anyone who just sits around. [They’re] grateful for what they have.”

Jenner joined Chalamet at the Palm Springs International Film Festival Awards on January 3 and at the Critics Choice Awards a day later.

The Marty Supreme star won Best Actor at the Critics Choice Awards and thanked Jenner at the end of his speech. He offered rare public remarks on their relationship, telling her and the crowd, “And lastly, I’ll just say thank you to my partner of three years. Thank you for our foundation. I love you. I couldn’t do this without you. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.” She seemed to mouth “I love you” in response from her seat:

The next weekend, Chalamet won Best Performance by a Male Actor in a Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy at the Golden Globes. He paid tribute to Jenner again in his acceptance speech, saying, “For my parents, for my partner, I love you.”

A day later, he soft-launched their relationship on Instagram. Jenner’s hand appears holding his Golden Globe trophy in the photo:

Jenner joined Chalamet at the Oscars, where he was nominated for Best Actor. The two were seated together during the ceremony and were photographed holding hands and staying close throughout the night.

They later attended the Vanity Fair Oscar Party, where they posed together on the red carpet. Jenner wore a custom McQueen dress with a cut-out, while Chalamet changed into a white Chrome Hearts suit. The pair continued to show PDA, with Chalamet placing his hand on Jenner’s waist and kissing her cheek.

Jenner and Chalamet appeared to give separate glimpses into the same tropical getaway. On March 30, both posted Instagram photo dumps within hours of each other, featuring similar scenery, including white sand beaches and clear turquoise water.

Jenner captioned her post simply, “heaven,” sharing several bikini photos, along with moments of her relaxing in the sun and unwinding indoors.

Chalamet, meanwhile, posted his own carousel that included shirtless beach shots and images of him swimming and riding a red jet ski. Jenner had posted nearly identical jet ski content days earlier, further fueling speculation that the two were vacationing together, despite not appearing in the same images.

Chalamet sneakily stepped out to support Jenner at the New York launch event for her Meta smart glasses collaboration. He kept a low profile at the event, wearing a hoodie and baseball cap.

After three years together, the couple remained happy with their current status. A source told People, “Kylie and Timmy are very much in love. They don’t have plans to rush an engagement. They love how their relationship is.”

The insider added that the couple recently “went away on a double vacation” with Kendall Jenner and Jacob Elordi for a “staycation” in Malibu.

Chalamet was seen driving up to Bird Streets Club, where Jenner was reportedly already inside with some friends. The actor pulled his SUV into a private garage, wearing a baseball cap low. Later, Anastasia Karanikolaou, Jake Shane, Mandana Bolourchi, and Jesse Jo Stark were spotted at the venue.

Chalamet was in the audience to support Jenner as she made her Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show debut in Los Angeles.

During Jenner’s surprise appearance on the runway, Chalamet was seen smiling and applauding from his seat beside her mother, who filmed the moment on her phone.

For her debut, Jenner wore the year’s $50 million Fantasy Bra featuring a large yellow diamond. She walked the runway with it and a large pair of Victoria’s Secret’s wings.

On November 15, Jenner and Chalamet stepped out at the Governors Awards in Los Angeles. Chalamet posed alone on the red carpet in a black tuxedo with a white shirt and bow tie.

Inside the event, the couple was seen sitting together at a table.
